# C7 site node (optional, first in the cut order)

**Status: no firmware written, nothing built.** The software side is ready: `heatbank/site/bias.py` reads the CSV below, learns a
forecast bias (upward only by default, see audit A7) and runs the V5 test.

## What it measures (environment only, never people)
air temperature, relative humidity, black-globe temperature, battery. Hourly means.

## CSV contract (`time_iso,tdb_c,rh_pct,tg_c,battery_pct`)
`time_iso` must match the forecast hour (e.g. `2026-11-18T11:00`). One row per hour. Declare the file in `DATA_SOURCES.md` as D3,
"generated by the team".

## Hardware notes (for the owner; not tested)
ESP32 or Arduino, a humidity/temperature sensor in a ventilated radiation shield, a 150 mm black globe (ISO 7726 formula is in
`heatbank/strain/radiant.py`) with a thermistor or digital probe at its centre. Duty-cycle the sensor, seal the box, log battery.
Calibrate against a reference thermometer before the V5 run and say how in the documentation. A thin globe or a bare thermistor in
sun will read wrong; V5 will show it.

## Demo of the plumbing only
`python -m heatbank.site.demo` generates a SYNTHETIC node file (site 2.5 C hotter than forecast) and runs V5 on it. This proves the
code path, not the sensor.
